aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio (e.g. "16:9", "9:16", "1:1"). MCP always snaps unsupported values to the closest ratio this model accepts — the card and the request both use the snapped value. Prefer list_models `supported_aspect_ratios`. Default: matches source.

duration.description: Output duration in seconds. Must be in `supported_durations` from list_models, OR within `min_output_duration`-`max_output_duration`. When the model publishes `elements_input_plus_output_max_seconds` (Wan 3.0 / Wan 3.0 Prime video-to-video: 30), source-video seconds + duration must stay within it — a 15s source leaves at most 15s of output, 10s leaves 20s. Exceeding it is a deterministic 400. Default: matches source

enhance_prompt.description: Enhance the prompt. Default: false — only pass true if the user explicitly asks to enhance/improve the prompt.

visual_dna_ids.description: Array of Visual DNA profile IDs to apply for character/style consistency. **Cap: pass at most `max_visual_dna` IDs from list_models for the chosen model; if `supports_visual_dna: false`, DNA is silently ignored.**

style_id.description: Morphious Styles only (kolbo-morphious-motion or kolbo-morphious-swap; Standard only, the Lite modes refuse a style): id of a look from list_morphious_styles (Kolbo catalog or a custom style the user made). Restyles the WHOLE video in that look; the style counts as reference image 1, so no reference_images are needed. Prompt optional.

draft.description: Special Draft mode. True forces 480p Draft even if resolution says 1080p; false selects regular video. Only supported when list_models advertises draft capabilities. For Seedance 2.5 editing use model seedance-2-5-video-to-video with generate_video_from_video; the source duration and aspect ratio are preserved. Uses ordinary credits; finalize through draft_quote then draft_enhance.

resolution.description: Video resolution or named tier: read supported_resolutions from list_models. For Seedance 2.5 Draft use resolution="480p-draft" on the matching public model: seedance-2-5 for creation, seedance-2-5-video-to-video for editing. Plain "480p" generates regular video, NOT Draft. Finalize an actual draft with edit_video operation="draft_quote" then "draft_enhance".

reference_images.description: Array of reference image URLs for models that support additional image inputs. **Cap: pass at most `max_images` URLs from list_models — if `max_images === 0` the model does not accept image refs.** Examples: character reference images for Kling O1/O3, style reference for Aleph/gen4_aleph, character image for WAN VACE video-edit.

reference_videos.description: Array of additional reference video URLs for models that support multiple video inputs. **Cap: pass at most `max_videos` URLs from list_models — if `max_videos <= 1` only the source_video is accepted.** Example: WAN 2.6 reference-to-video accepts 1–3 reference videos.

elements.description: Array of element image URLs. **Cap: pass at most `max_elements` URLs from list_models — if `max_elements === 0` the model does not accept elements.** Elements are style or character reference assets alongside the main video.

sound_enabled.description: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) AI-generated synced audio on the output video. Honored by `sound_generation_type: "native"` models (Kling O3/V3, Veo 3.1, PixVerse V6). Omit to use `sound_enabled_by_default`. Enabling sound may apply `sound_credit_multiplier` to cost.

preset.description: VEED Subtitles only: caption style preset (e.g. "glass", "whisper", "fusion", "simple", "vegas"). Call list_models type="video_to_video" for the veed/subtitles model. Ignored by other models.

source_language.description: VEED Subtitles only: BCP-47 code of the spoken language to improve transcription accuracy (e.g. "en-US", "es-ES", "he-IL"). Omit to auto-detect.

translation_language.description: VEED Subtitles only: BCP-47 code to translate the subtitles into (e.g. "en-US", "fr-FR"). Omit to keep the original spoken language.

srt_content.description: VEED Subtitles only: raw .srt subtitle text to burn in. When set, auto-transcription is skipped.

srt_file_url.description: VEED Subtitles only: URL to a .srt subtitle file. Alternative to srt_content. When set, auto-transcription is skipped.

vocabulary.description: VEED Subtitles only: brand names / jargon to help transcription (e.g. [{"word":"Kolbo","replaces":["colbo","kolboo"]}]). Ignored when srt_content / srt_file_url is set.

customization.description: VEED Subtitles only: style overrides. Any omitted field keeps the preset default. Best supported by Basic presets.

position.description: Caption vertical position. Ignored by complex animated presets.

baseline.description: All words: Google font name, weight 100-900, hex colour.

enhancement_model.description: Topaz Slow Motion only (model "topaz/interpolate/video"): retiming engine — "Apollo" (smooth motion, default), "Chronos" (complex motion and occlusion), or "Aion" (highest quality for extreme slow motion, and the most expensive).

keep_original_sound.description: Kling 4 video edit: preserve source audio (default true); false creates synchronized audio.

last_frame_url.description: Kling 4 video extend: optional target final-frame HTTPS image URL.

target_fps.description: Topaz Slow Motion only: frames per second of the OUTPUT (16-120, default 60). Higher rates generate more frames and cost proportionally more.

slowdown_factor.description: Topaz Slow Motion only: how many times longer the output runs (1-8, default 1). 4 turns a 5s clip into 20s of slow motion. Billing is on the OUTPUT length, so an 8x pass costs 8x a 1x pass.

output_format.description: Topaz HDR only (model "topaz/sdr-to-hdr/video"): "mp4" for 10-bit H.265 HDR10 (default) or "prores" for 10-bit ProRes 422 HQ. Both are HDR masters — the in-app player shows a tone-mapped SDR preview and the HDR file is the download.

project_id.description: Project ObjectId to drop this generation into. Call `list_projects` to discover IDs (the API has no concept of project names — only ObjectIds). IMPORTANT: this is per-call, NOT sticky — once the user has named a working project, pass its id on EVERY generation call in the conversation; any call that omits it silently lands in the default "API Generations" project instead. Requires owner / edit / full permission on the project; view-only is rejected.

session_id.description: Existing session to add this generation to, so a related set lands in ONE session instead of a stack of single-item sessions in the Kolbo sidebar. HOW TO USE: omit it on the FIRST call of a PLAN BUCKET (Cast, Locations, Props, or one Scene NN), read `session_id` off that result, `rename_session` to the plan name, then pass that SAME value on every follow-up in that bucket (another character, shot 2, a retake, "make it darker"). Only omit it again when the plan starts a NEW scene or NEW concept — never per take or per tool call. Image tools and video tools cannot share an id. `list_sessions` also returns ids. When set, `project_id` is ignored — the session's own project wins.

lines_per_subtitle.description: SRT: max lines per subtitle cue, 1–4. Default: 2.

tools.name: generate_3d
tools.description: Generate a 3D model from a text prompt, a single reference image, or multiple reference images (for multi-view reconstruction). Returns model URLs in multiple formats (GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ). Modes: "text" (prompt-only), "single" (one image), "multi" (multiple images for better quality). The mode is auto-detected from the inputs if not specified. Three model families with family-scoped settings: Meshy V7 (mesh/texture controls should_remesh/should_texture/texture_image_url/symmetry_mode/enable_safety_checker, plus auto-rigging + animation: enable_rigging rigs a humanoid character with basic walk

prompt.description: Text description of the 3D object to generate (used in text mode and also as a hint in image modes)

reference_images.description: Array of image URLs or absolute local paths. 1 image → single mode, 2+ → multi mode.

mode.description: Explicitly set mode: "text" | "single" | "multi". Auto-detected from reference_images if omitted.

texture_prompt.description: Optional prompt to guide texture generation

model.description: Model identifier. Use list_models type="three_d" to see all 3D options, or filter by sub-type: "3d_text_to_model", "3d_image_to_model", "3d_multi_image_to_model", "3d_world".

should_remesh.description: Rebuild the mesh with clean game-ready topology (Meshy V7 only, default true). False keeps the raw reconstructed mesh.

should_texture.description: Generate textures (Meshy V7 only, default true). False produces an untextured mesh at a lower credit cost; disables enable_pbr/texture_prompt/texture_image_url.

texture_image_url.description: URL of a 2D image to guide texturing (Meshy V7 only). Requires should_texture.

enable_safety_checker.description: Screen input images before generation (Meshy V7 only, default true)

enable_rigging.description: Auto-rig the model as a humanoid character with basic walk/run animations (Meshy V7 only, default false). Best results with clearly defined limbs. Costs extra credits.

rigging_height_meters.description: Approximate character height in meters (Meshy V7 only, default 1.7). Only used when enable_rigging is true.

enable_animation.description: Apply an animation preset to the rigged model (Meshy V7 only, default false). Requires enable_rigging. Costs extra credits on top of rigging.

animation_action_id.description: Animation preset ID, 0-696, default 92 ("Idle") (Meshy V7 only). Only used when enable_animation is true. See docs.meshy.ai/en/api/animation-library for the preset catalog.

art_style.description: "realistic" | "sculpture" (Meshy text mode only). Sculpture disables PBR.

enable_prompt_expansion.description: AI-expand the prompt before generation (Meshy text mode only)

ss_sampling_steps.description: Sparse-structure sampling steps (Trellis only) — more steps = higher quality, slower

multiimage_algo.description: "stochastic" | "multidiffusion" — multi-image fusion algorithm (Trellis v1 multi mode only)

decimation_target.description: Target polygon count after decimation (Trellis 2 only)

remesh.description: Remesh with projection (Trellis 2 only, default true)

project_id.description: Project ObjectId to drop this generation into. Call `list_projects` to discover IDs (the API has no concept of project names — only ObjectIds). IMPORTANT: this is per-call, NOT sticky — once the user has named a working project, pass its id on EVERY generation call in the conversation; any call that omits it silently lands in the default "API Generations" project instead. Requires owner / edit / full permission on the project; view-only is rejected.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Apply a targeted AI edit to an existing image. Covers mechanical enhancements (upscale, remove background, skin retouching) AND creative operations (expand/outpaint, reframe, inpaint, erase, face swap, background replace, camera angle, multi-shot grid, split/upscale). ⚠️ To EXPAND an image / add space / widen it to a new aspect ratio while keeping the existing artwork intact, use operation="zoom_out" — NOT "reframe" (reframe re-generates the whole picture). ⚠️ For open-ended PROMPT-DRIVEN content edits — "make it night", restyling, adding/removing objects — use `generate_image_edit` instead; i

image_url.description: URL or absolute local path of the primary source image to edit.

operation.description: Edit operation: "upscale" — increase resolution by 2×, 3×, or 4× (use `scale`). "clarity_upscale" — AI-powered clarity upscale with detail enhancement (use `resolution`). "zoom_out" — THE default way to expand / extend / outpaint / uncrop / widen an image, or to grow it into a wider or taller frame. The original pixels are PRESERVED and only the new area around them is generated. Expand uniformly with `zoom_out_percentage`, or in one direction with `expand_left` / `expand_right` / `expand_top` / `expand_bottom` (pixels — this is how you hit a target aspect ratio: read the source width/height, then add the missing pixels on the side you want). `prompt` describes what should appear in the NEW space only. Note: `aspect_ratio` is ignored by this operation. "reframe" — RE-GENERATES the entire picture at a new aspect ratio (Luma Photon). The subject is re-imagined, not preserved — expect a different-looking image. Use ONLY when the user explicitly wants the shot re-taken in another format. If they said "expand", "extend", "widen", "uncrop", "add space", "fill the sides", or "keep it the same but 16:9", they want "zoom_out" instead. Requires `aspect_ratio`. "removebg" — remove the image background, output is transparent PNG. "background_replace" — remove background and replace it with AI-generated content from `prompt`. "enhance_skin" — realistic skin texture on portraits (Enhancor). `skin_strength`: "subtle" (barely visible — avoid unless asked), "realistic" (default, visible pore/texture detail; add `fix_lighting=true` to also even out lighting), "pimple" (removes blemishes), "freckle" (adds freckles — set `freckle_intensity`). Works on visible faces: on a full-body shot or a multi-panel character sheet the face is small and the change is hard to see — run it on a face close-up or crop instead. "enhance" — Topaz photo correction at the SOURCE resolution (no resizing). Pick the tool with `model`: "topaz/adjust/image" (exposure, white balance, or colorizing a black-and-white photo), "topaz/sharpen/image" (lens / motion / portrait / wildlife blur, or Super Focus for severely blurred shots), "topaz/denoise/image" (high-ISO and night noise), "topaz/restore/image" (old or damaged photos, dust and scratches). Choose the specific engine with `enhancement_model` — call list_models type="graphics_enhance" to see each model's engines. To make an image BIGGER use "upscale" instead. "inpaint" — paint over a masked area using `mask_image_url` (B&W mask, white = fill area) and optional `prompt`. Add reference images via `additional_images`. "erase" — erase an object defined by `mask_image_url` (white = erase area). "face_swap" — swap the face in `image_url` with the face from `mask_image_url` (required). "camera_angle" — generate the image from a different camera angle. Set the view with `horizontal_angle` / `vertical_angle` / `camera_zoom` (preferred — exact), or describe it in `prompt` ("left side", "back", "low angle", "bird's eye", "close up", "wide"); with neither, the view barely changes. Set `generate_all_angles=true` for the 12-angle set. "split" — split the image into a 3×3 grid of tiles. "split_upscale" — split into a grid and upscale each tile. "multi_shot" — generate a 3×3 multi-shot grid of scenes (uses `additional_images` as reference shots). Use `resolution` for output quality. "magic_edit" (DEPRECATED) — prompt-driven content edit. Prefer `generate_image_edit` for better results.

model.description: Concrete model identifier for this operation. Dynamically discover it with list_models using the operation-specific type: upscale/clarity_upscale/split_upscale → "image_upscale"; reframe → "image_reframe"; zoom_out → "image_zoom_out"; inpaint → "inpaint"; erase → "erase"; face_swap → "face_swap"; removebg → "background_remove"; background_replace → "background_replace"; enhance_skin → "skin_enhancer"; enhance → "graphics_enhance"; magic_edit/camera_angle → "image_editing". multi_shot and split use pinned/non-selectable processing, so omit model for those operations. Omit elsewhere to use the platform default. Never pass a kolbo_gateway_* navigation alias.

scale.description: Upscale factor: 1, 2 or 4. Used with operation="upscale". Default: 2. There is NO 8 — every Topaz split endpoint declares upscale_factor max 4 in its OpenAPI, so an 8 is a guaranteed provider error. Output size is otherwise unbounded: 4x on a 4K source is a 16K result and is priced pro-rata, not refused.

enhancement_model.description: Topaz engine. With operation="upscale" on model "topaz/upscale/image" it selects the engine family: "Standard V2" / "High Fidelity V3" / "CGI" / "Text Refine" (faithful), "Wonder 3.5" (rebuilds natural detail), "Bloom 2" (reinvents detail — most expensive), "Transparent" (keeps the alpha channel). With operation="enhance" it selects the correction engine for the chosen model. Omit for the model default. Call list_models to see the engines a model offers.

output_format.description: Output image format: "jpeg" or "png". Used with Topaz "upscale" and "enhance". Defaults to jpeg (the transparent upscaler always returns png).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio (e.g. "16:9", "9:16", "1:1"). MCP always snaps unsupported values to the closest ratio this model accepts — the card and the request both use the snapped value. Prefer list_models `supported_aspect_ratios`. Required for operation="reframe". Ignored by "zoom_out" — size that expansion with `zoom_out_percentage` or the `expand_*` pixel args.

zoom_out_percentage.description: How much to expand outward on ALL sides, as a percentage (0-90). Used with operation="zoom_out". Default: 20. Ignored when any `expand_*` arg is set.

expand_left.description: Pixels of new AI-generated content to add on the LEFT. Used with operation="zoom_out" (0-700). This is how you widen an image asymmetrically, e.g. to turn a 16:9 frame into 21:9 without touching the subject.

expand_right.description: Pixels of new AI-generated content to add on the RIGHT. Used with operation="zoom_out" (0-700).

expand_top.description: Pixels of new AI-generated content to add on TOP. Used with operation="zoom_out" (0-700).

expand_bottom.description: Pixels of new AI-generated content to add on the BOTTOM. Used with operation="zoom_out" (0-700).

skin_strength.description: Skin enhancement preset. Used with operation="enhance_skin". Default: "realistic". "subtle" changes very little.

freckle_intensity.description: Freckle amount: 0, 50 or 100. Used with operation="enhance_skin" and skin_strength="freckle". Default: 50.

fix_lighting.description: Also correct uneven / flat lighting on the face. Used with operation="enhance_skin" and skin_strength="realistic". Default: false.

horizontal_angle.description: Camera rotation around the subject in degrees (0-360; 0 = unchanged, 90 = right side, 180 = behind). Used with operation="camera_angle" when generate_all_angles is not set.

vertical_angle.description: Camera tilt in degrees (-30 = from below, 0 = eye level, 90 = straight down). Used with operation="camera_angle".

camera_zoom.description: Camera distance (0 = far, 5 = unchanged, 10 = close-up). Used with operation="camera_angle". Default: 5.

face_enhancement.description: Topaz face recovery. Used with operation="upscale" on Topaz precision/generative engines. Default: true — set false to keep faces exactly as in the source.

face_enhancement_strength.description: How strongly faces are recovered (0-1). Used with operation="upscale" (Topaz). Default: 0.8.

face_enhancement_creativity.description: How much new facial detail Topaz may invent (0-1; 0 = faithful). Used with operation="upscale". Default: 0.

subject_detection.description: Which part Topaz enhances. Used with operation="upscale". Default: "All".

crop_to_fill.description: Crop to fill the target size instead of keeping the source framing. Used with operation="upscale" (Topaz). Default: false.

creativity.description: How much new detail is invented. operation="clarity_upscale": 0-1 (default 0.35). operation="upscale" with the Bloom (creative) engine: 1-9.

resemblance.description: How closely the result must match the source (0-1). Used with operation="clarity_upscale". Default: 0.6.

background_reference_image.description: URL or absolute local path of an image to use as the new background. Used with operation="background_replace" (prompt still required).

negative_prompt.description: What must NOT appear. Used with operation="background_replace" and "clarity_upscale".

split_layout.description: Grid to split into: "auto" (detect), "2x2", "3x3" or "4x4". Used with operation="split" / "split_upscale". Default: "auto".

mask_expansion.description: Pixels to grow the erase mask so edges blend. Used with operation="erase". Default: 15.

prompt.description: Text instruction guiding the edit. Required for "background_replace". Used with "inpaint", "zoom_out", "camera_angle", and the deprecated "magic_edit". For "zoom_out" it describes what fills the NEW space only — the original image is left as-is.

mask_image_url.description: URL or absolute local path of a mask image (black & white; white = affected area). Required for "inpaint" and "erase". For "face_swap", this is the face reference image.

additional_images.description: Extra reference images — URLs or absolute local paths (up to 8). For "inpaint": reference images that guide style/content. For "multi_shot": the set of scene reference shots. For "magic_edit": additional source images for composite edits.

generate_all_angles.description: When true, generates a full set of camera angles instead of just one. Only used with operation="camera_angle".

quality.description: Output quality preset (e.g. "high", "standard"). Applies where the underlying model supports quality tiers.

ai_optimize.description: Whether to let Kolbo AI enhance your prompt before sending to the model. Default: false — your prompt reaches the model exactly as written. Only pass true if the user explicitly asks to enhance/improve the prompt.

project_id.description: Project ObjectId to drop this generation into. Call `list_projects` to discover IDs (the API has no concept of project names — only ObjectIds). IMPORTANT: this is per-call, NOT sticky — once the user has named a working project, pass its id on EVERY generation call in the conversation; any call that omits it silently lands in the default "API Generations" project instead. Requires owner / edit / full permission on the project; view-only is rejected.

session_id.description: Existing session to add this generation to, so a related set lands in ONE session instead of a stack of single-item sessions in the Kolbo sidebar. HOW TO USE: omit it on the FIRST call of a PLAN BUCKET (Cast, Locations, Props, or one Scene NN), read `session_id` off that result, `rename_session` to the plan name, then pass that SAME value on every follow-up in that bucket (another character, shot 2, a retake, "make it darker"). Only omit it again when the plan starts a NEW scene or NEW concept — never per take or per tool call. Image tools and video tools cannot share an id. `list_sessions` also returns ids. When set, `project_id` is ignored — the session's own project wins.

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description: Apply a targeted AI edit to an existing video. Covers both mechanical edits (upscale, reframe, remove watermark, remove background) and creative operations (generate audio, face swap, extend, lipsync, inpaint, retake, magic edit). Returns the edited video URL when complete. LOCAL FILE? Absolute local paths work here (server and client share a filesystem). Never reply that you cannot upload files — for a file you will reference more than once, call `upload_media` first and reuse the returned https:// URL. IMAGE/VIDEO PASTED OR ATTACHED IN THIS CHAT with no path? You can see it but Kolbo cannot

video_url.description: URL of the source video to edit.

operation.description: Edit operation: "draft_enhance" — render an owned saved draft at full quality in its original project. Pass `resolution` from the draft model capabilities; the server selects its finalization engine. No prompt or provider task ID is needed. "draft_quote" — check a saved draft’s supported final resolutions, expiry and exact credit cost without starting a render. Use this before draft_enhance. "upscale" — boost to 4K/2K resolution (use `scale` for factor, `resolution` for target, `target_fps` for frame rate). On model "blackforestlabs/flux-video-upscale" (Flux Video Upscale): `scale` is 1.5-3x (no named `resolution` target — billed on the OUTPUT tier it lands in), `mode` is "precise" (source-faithful, default) or "creative" (reimagines detail — a pricier tier), and `prompt` optionally guides the creative-mode enhancement. On model "bytedance-upscaler/upscale/video" (Bytedance Upscaler): `resolution` is "1080p" | "2k" | "4k" | "6k" | "8k" (OR `scale_ratio` 1.1-10, output ≤4K), plus `target_fps` (24-120), `enhancement_tier`, `enhancement_preset`, `fidelity`, `bit_depth` — see each field. Price = resolution tier (1080p 1 · 2k 2 · 4k 4 · 6k 8 · 8k 16 credits/s) × every started 30 fps (60 = 2×, 120 = 4×) × tier (fast 0.5×, pro 10×). Source-length caps: 6K 120s, 8K 60s, Pro 30s, otherwise 300s. "reframe" — change aspect ratio (requires `aspect_ratio`; use `grid_position_x`/`grid_position_y` to control where the original sits). "generate_audio" — add AI-generated audio from `prompt`. Optionally split into `sound_effect_prompt` and `background_music_prompt`. Set `original_sound=true` to keep original audio alongside. On model "mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/video-to-video" (Mirelo SFX 2.0) the prompt is optional (it watches the clip and builds a full synced sound design, up to 10 minutes): `preserve_speech` keeps the dialogue (default true), `negative_prompt` keeps sounds out, `num_samples` returns 1-4 variations (each billed), `seed` repeats a result, and `duration` makes a shorter soundtrack by TRIMMING the video (omit for the whole clip). "remove_watermark" — AI-powered watermark removal. "face_swap" — replace the face in the video with the face from `image_url` (required). "extend" — lengthen the video at `mode` ("start" or "end") by `duration` seconds. Optional `prompt` and `context` guide the generated content. "magic_edit" — restyle or transform the video with `prompt` (required). "lipsync" — sync a face to audio. Provide `audio_url` (audio file) OR `text_prompt` (will synthesize speech). "remove_background" — remove or greenscreen the video background. Use `refine_edges=true` for cleaner cutouts, `subject_is_person=true` for portrait-optimized mode. "inpaint" — replace a region of the video. Provide `mask_video_url` (B&W mask, white=fill area), `prompt` for what to generate, and optionally `object_prompt` (what to replace) and `video_strength` (0–1, how strongly to follow the original). "retake" — regenerate a segment of the video. Use `start_time` (seconds) + `duration` + optional `prompt`.

model.description: Concrete model identifier for this operation. Dynamically discover it with list_models using the operation-specific type: upscale → "video_upscale"; reframe → "video_reframe"; generate_audio → "video_to_sound"; remove_watermark → "video_watermark_removal"; face_swap → "video_face_swap"; extend → "video_extend"; magic_edit → "video_to_video"; lipsync → "lipsync-video"; remove_background → "video_background_removal"; inpaint → "video_inpaint"; retake → "video_retake". Compare the returned credit, supported resolutions/aspect ratios, duration limits, resolution multipliers, and params, then pass a concrete identifier. Omit to use the platform default. Never pass a kolbo_gateway_* navigation alias.

scale.description: Upscale factor (e.g. 2, 4). Used with operation="upscale". On "blackforestlabs/flux-video-upscale" the valid range is 1.5-3 (default 2).

resolution.description: Target resolution (e.g. "4k", "2k", "1080p"; Bytedance Upscaler also "6k", "8k"). Used with "upscale" and "reframe". Not used by "blackforestlabs/flux-video-upscale" — use `scale` instead. On "prunaai/p-video-upscale" (P Video Upscale) read the allowed values, per-target frame caps and prices from list_models type="video_upscale" (params.target_resolution; default 1080p).

target_fps.description: Target frame rate (e.g. 24, 30, 60). Used with operation="upscale". Bytedance Upscaler: 24-120, default 30; price multiplies per started 30 fps. P Video Upscale: whole fps 16-60 (unset keeps the source rate); output above 30 fps costs double.

enhancement_model.description: Topaz enhancement engine for operation="upscale" on model "topaz/upscale/video". Families: Precision (faithful — "Proteus", "Artemis High Quality", "Iris", "Dione TV", "Gaia CG", "Gaia 2"), Denoise ("Nyx", "Nyx Fast"), Generative (rebuilds detail that is not in the source — "Starlight Fast 2", "Starlight HQ", "Starlight Precise 2.6"), Creative ("Astra 2", always renders 4K). Generative and Creative engines cost several times the Precision rate. Omit for the default.

enhancement_tier.description: Bytedance Upscaler quality tier for operation="upscale". "fast" = half price, lighter enhancement; "standard" (default); "pro" = large-model restoration at 10× credits, source ≤30s, required for 10/12-bit.

enhancement_preset.description: Bytedance Upscaler content type for operation="upscale": "general" (default), "ugc" (phone/social shorts), "short_series" (short dramas), "aigc" (AI-generated footage), "old_film" (classic film restoration). Same price for all.

fidelity.description: Bytedance Upscaler enhancement strength for operation="upscale": "high" (default, mild and source-faithful) or "medium" (stronger, balanced). Same price.

bit_depth.description: Bytedance Upscaler output bit depth for operation="upscale": 8 (default), 10 or 12. 10/12 require enhancement_tier="pro" and are delivered as HEVC.

scale_ratio.description: Bytedance Upscaler custom scale (1.1-10) for operation="upscale", used INSTEAD of `resolution`. Output must stay within 4K; billed on the 1080p/2k/4k tier it lands in. For 6K/8K use `resolution`.

turbo.description: P Video Upscale ("prunaai/p-video-upscale") only: faster generation, slightly lower quality, same price. Used with operation="upscale".

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio (e.g. "16:9", "9:16", "1:1"). MCP always snaps unsupported values to the closest ratio this model accepts — the card and the request both use the snapped value. Prefer list_models `supported_aspect_ratios`. Required for operation="reframe".

grid_position_x.description: Horizontal position (0.0–1.0) of the original content within the reframed canvas. Used with "reframe". Default: 0.5 (center).

grid_position_y.description: Vertical position (0.0–1.0) of the original content within the reframed canvas. Used with "reframe". Default: 0.5 (center).

prompt.description: Text prompt. Required for "magic_edit". Used with "generate_audio", "extend", "inpaint", "retake", optionally "lipsync" (for text-to-speech instead of audio_url), and optionally "upscale" on model "blackforestlabs/flux-video-upscale" (guides creative-mode detail enhancement).

sound_effect_prompt.description: Separate prompt for sound effects layer. Used with operation="generate_audio" when you want to specify SFX and music independently.

background_music_prompt.description: Separate prompt for background music layer. Used with operation="generate_audio" alongside `sound_effect_prompt`.

original_sound.description: When true, keeps the original video audio and mixes in the generated audio. Used with "generate_audio". Default: false.

cfg_strength.description: Guidance strength for audio generation (higher = follows prompt more strictly). Used with "generate_audio".

audio_format.description: Separate generated-audio format for Sonilo sound-effects models. Read output_audio_formats/default_output_audio_format from list_models; default is "aac".

segments.description: Optional contiguous Sonilo sound-design ranges. The first start must be 0, each end must equal the next start, and the final end must not exceed the video duration. Omit to let Sonilo detect scenes automatically.

negative_prompt.description: Mirelo SFX 2.0 (operation="generate_audio"): sounds to keep out, as a short comma-separated list, e.g. "music, crowd noise".

preserve_speech.description: Mirelo SFX 2.0 (operation="generate_audio"): true (default) keeps the dialogue and builds the soundtrack around it; false makes sound effects only and suppresses speech.

num_samples.description: Mirelo SFX 2.0 (operation="generate_audio"): number of variations, 1-4 (default 1). Each is billed; all result URLs are returned.

seed.description: Mirelo SFX 2.0 (operation="generate_audio"): seed for repeatable results (-1 or omit = random).

image_url.description: URL of the reference face image. Required for operation="face_swap".

duration.description: Seconds of content to generate. Used with "extend" (required) and "retake" (optional). Typical range: 1–20. With "generate_audio" on Mirelo SFX 2.0: seconds of sound (1-600) — the returned video is TRIMMED to this length; omit for the whole clip.

mode.description: Extension direction: "start" or "end". Used with "extend". For "retake": replacement mode (default: "replace_audio_and_video"). For "upscale" on model "blackforestlabs/flux-video-upscale": "precise" (source-faithful, default) or "creative" (reimagines detail — pricier). Default: "end".

context.description: Additional context to guide what gets generated in the extended segment. Used with "extend".

audio_url.description: URL of the audio track to sync to the face. Required for "lipsync" unless `text_prompt` is provided.

text_prompt.description: Text to synthesize as speech and sync to the face. Used with "lipsync" as an alternative to `audio_url`.

refine_edges.description: Apply edge refinement for cleaner background removal. Used with "remove_background". Default: false.

subject_is_person.description: Optimize background removal for a human subject (portrait mode). Used with "remove_background". Default: false.

mask_video_url.description: URL of a mask video (B&W; white = area to fill). Used with operation="inpaint".

object_prompt.description: Description of the object being replaced (helps the model understand what to remove). Used with "inpaint".

video_strength.description: How closely to follow the original video (0.0–1.0; higher = closer to original). Used with "inpaint".

start_time.description: Start time in seconds of the segment to retake. Used with operation="retake".

project_id.description: Project ObjectId to drop this generation into. Call `list_projects` to discover IDs (the API has no concept of project names — only ObjectIds). IMPORTANT: this is per-call, NOT sticky — once the user has named a working project, pass its id on EVERY generation call in the conversation; any call that omits it silently lands in the default "API Generations" project instead. Requires owner / edit / full permission on the project; view-only is rejected.

session_id.description: Existing session to add this generation to, so a related set lands in ONE session instead of a stack of single-item sessions in the Kolbo sidebar. HOW TO USE: omit it on the FIRST call of a PLAN BUCKET (Cast, Locations, Props, or one Scene NN), read `session_id` off that result, `rename_session` to the plan name, then pass that SAME value on every follow-up in that bucket (another character, shot 2, a retake, "make it darker"). Only omit it again when the plan starts a NEW scene or NEW concept — never per take or per tool call. Image tools and video tools cannot share an id. `list_sessions` also returns ids. When set, `project_id` is ignored — the session's own project wins.

tools.name: trim_video
tools.description: Cut a section out of a video by start/end time (frame-accurate server-side trim, no credits for AI generation — pure processing). Source must be a Kolbo-hosted video URL (generated output or upload_media result). The tool waits for the job to finish (usually seconds) and returns the trimmed video URL.

video_url.description: Kolbo-hosted URL of the source video.

end_time.description: Trim end, in seconds (> start_time, max 3600).

project_id.description: Project to file the trimmed video into (from list_projects).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available AI models on Kolbo. Filter by `type` to narrow to a generation type, and pass `format: "json"` to enumerate the catalog with exact identifiers — `format: "json"` + `type` returns the full raw model documents (every constraint field, for programmatic comparison / cap validation before submitting a generation); `format: "json"` alone returns a compact index of EVERY model and its identifier. Default `format: "text"` returns the human-readable summary. NEVER guess a model identifier: call this tool. ⚠️ COST: video / firstlast / elements / motion_graphic / cast rates are normally pe

type.description: Filter by DB type name. Generation: "text_to_img", "image_editing", "text_to_video", "img_to_video", "draw_to_video", "video_to_video", "elements", "firstlastgenerations", "lipsync-image", "lipsync-video", "music_gen", "text_to_speech", "text_to_sound", "stt", "text". Image-edit engines: "image_upscale", "image_reframe", "image_zoom_out", "inpaint", "erase", "face_swap", "background_remove", "background_replace", "skin_enhancer", "graphics_enhance". Video-edit engines: "video_upscale", "video_reframe", "video_background_removal", "video_to_sound", "video_face_swap", "video_watermark_removal", "video_extend", "video_inpaint", "video_retake". For edit_image/edit_video, query the operation-specific type and pass a CONCRETE returned identifier; never submit a kolbo_gateway_* row, because those are web-navigation aliases rather than AI engines. Legacy aliases also accepted: "image", "image_edit", "video", "video_from_image", "video_from_video", "music", "speech", "sound", "chat", "lipsync", "three_d", "first_last_frame", "transcription". Omit for all models.

format.description: Output format. "text" (default) returns a human-readable summary with the most-used caps. "json" is the source of truth for identifiers and caps: with `type` it returns the raw model documents from the API (identifier, credit, supported_durations, supported_resolutions, supported_aspect_ratios, max_reference_images, max_visual_dna, max_video_duration, …) for EVERY model of that type; without `type` it returns a compact index of every model in the catalog and its exact identifier. Use it whenever you need an identifier you have not seen listed, or must verify a cap before passing a value that might exceed a model-specific limit.

display_catalog.description: Set true when the USER explicitly asked to see/browse the available models — the visual catalog opens expanded. Leave unset for internal lookups (verifying a model name, checking caps before a generation): the catalog stays collapsed to a single row the user can tap to browse.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check your remaining Kolbo credit balance.

tools.name: get_session_usage
tools.description: Fetch real, multiplier-adjusted credit spend for the current Kolbo Code app session. Use when the user asks "how much did I spend?" or before/after a large bulk job so you can quote actual cost (not an estimate from base credits). Returns total + per-tool breakdown + per-model breakdown + a recent list. The caller-session-id is forwarded automatically by the MCP HTTP client. ONLY works when running under Kolbo Code — on the claude.ai connector and other hosts there is no per-app session to scope to; use check_credits there instead.

tools.name: show_plans
tools.description: Show the user their Kolbo credit balance, current plan, and the available upgrade plans / credit packs as an interactive card. Use when the user asks about pricing, plans, upgrading, or how to get more credits. Prices shown are live and promo-adjusted. The card links to app.kolbo.ai/pricing to complete a purchase — never quote prices from memory, and never claim to have made a purchase for them.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List available TTS voices for speech generation. Filter by language, gender, or provider to find the right voice. Returns voice_id, name, provider, language, gender, accent, description, styles, and preview_url for each voice. The catalogue runs to hundreds of voices, so results are paginated: filter first, then use `page` to walk the rest.

language.description: Filter by language name (e.g. "english", "hebrew", "spanish", "french") or locale code ("he", "he-IL"). Case-insensitive partial match.

provider.description: Filter by provider (e.g. "elevenlabs", "google"). Omit for all providers.

tools.name: clone_voice
tools.description: Clone a custom TTS voice from an audio sample (the user's voice or any voice they own the rights to). One-time setup cost depends on the provider — confirm with the user before firing. Providers (sample length, setup credits): "cartesia" (recommended, 3s–60s, 10; a full 60 s clean sample clones best), "elevenlabs" (8s–180s, 30), "kolbo" (Kolbo Voice Clone, 1s–60s, free), "fish-audio" (10s–120s, free), "heygen" (10s–180s, 75), "deepdub" (2s–300s, free), "minimax" (10s–180s, 400). After cloning, the voice appears in `list_voices` and can be used with generate_speech. Free plan caps at 3 custom v

audio.description: URL or absolute local path of the voice sample audio (any common format; converted server-side).

provider.description: Cloning provider (same set as the app's voice cloning). Default: cartesia (recommended).

language.description: Optional language hint (auto-detected when omitted).

project_id.description: Project to associate the voice with (from list_projects). Omit for the default project.

tools.name: import_elevenlabs_voice
tools.description: Import a voice from the ElevenLabs voice library into the user's Kolbo voices by its ElevenLabs voice ID. Use when the user already has/knows a specific ElevenLabs voice they want available for generate_speech.

elevenlabs_voice_id.description: The ElevenLabs voice ID to import.

project_id.description: Project to associate the voice with. Omit for the default project.

tools.name: delete_voice
tools.description: Delete one of the user's custom cloned voices (owner only, soft delete). Preset/platform voices cannot be deleted. Confirm with the user first.

voice_id.description: The custom voice id to delete (from list_voices — custom voices only).

tools.name: chat_send_message
tools.description: Send a chat message to Kolbo AI. Starts a new conversation (omit session_id) or continues an existing one. Returns the assistant response when complete. Supports image/video/audio analysis via media_urls — pass public URLs and the model auto-routes to a vision-capable model (e.g. Gemini) when media is detected. Supports web search and deep think modes. LOCAL FILE? Absolute local paths work here (server and client share a filesystem). Never reply that you cannot upload files — for a file you will reference more than once, call `upload_media` first and reuse the returned https:// URL. IMAGE/VIDE

model.description: Model identifier from list_models type="text". Identifiers resolve leniently, so the DISPLAY NAME that list_models shows works too ("Grok 4.5" → its identifier). Do NOT hardcode an id you have not seen in list_models — the text catalog turns over fast. Prefer passing a SPECIFIC model — omitting falls back to Smart Select auto-routing, which we avoid unless the user explicitly asks for auto-pick. Choose it by matching the task to each model's STRENGTHS SUMMARY in `list_models type="text"` — not by the newest/biggest name. Chat bills PER TOKEN, so the listed credit number is not the cost: a frontier model (Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Pro-class) costs 5-30x a mid-tier one per reply. Default ordinary chat (writing, brainstorming, Q&A, summarising) to a balanced mid-tier model whose summary covers the task (Claude Sonnet, Gemini Flash, GPT nano/mini class) and reserve the frontier tier for hard reasoning or long-form code the user asked for. Exception: when media_urls contains video or audio, omitting is fine — routing goes to a Gemini vision model regardless of this field.

session_id.description: Existing chat session ID to continue. Omit to start a new conversation.

system_prompt.description: System prompt for the conversation. Only applied when creating a new session.

web_search.description: Enable web search for this message. Default: false

deep_think.description: Enable deep think (extended reasoning). Default: false

thinking_level.description: Thinking effort ID from list_models type="text" thinkingLevels. The server uses the model catalog default when omitted or invalid. Separate from legacy deep_think; safeguards take precedence.

routing_mode.description: Auto routing mode. Use fast, balanced, or smart when model is Auto; omitted uses the server default (balanced).

enhance_prompt.description: Enhance the prompt. Default: false — only pass true if the user explicitly asks to enhance/improve the prompt.

media_urls.description: Public URLs of images, videos, or audio files to analyze. The model auto-routes to a vision-capable model when media is present. For a local file, get a URL first via the LOCAL FILE route in this tool's description.

project_id.description: Project ObjectId to drop this generation into. Call `list_projects` to discover IDs (the API has no concept of project names — only ObjectIds). IMPORTANT: this is per-call, NOT sticky — once the user has named a working project, pass its id on EVERY generation call in the conversation; any call that omits it silently lands in the default "API Generations" project instead. Requires owner / edit / full permission on the project; view-only is rejected.

tools.name: chat_list_conversations
tools.description: List the user's chat conversations across ALL projects, most-recent first. Returns session_id, name, project_id, and activity timestamps. Pass `project_id` to narrow to one project (resolve names via `list_projects`).

project_id.description: Restrict to conversations in one project (Mongo ObjectId from `list_projects`). Omit to list across all projects.

tools.name: chat_get_messages
tools.description: Fetch messages in a chat conversation. Returns role, content, model, and any media URLs attached to each message.

session_id.description: The chat session ID

tools.name: create_visual_dna
tools.description: Create a Visual DNA profile from reference media: any mix of up to 4 images, 1 video (3-10s) and 1 voice clip (5-30s). ANY ONE of them is enough — a video-only DNA (its frames are analyzed and a mid-clip frame becomes its face) or a voice-only DNA (dna_type must be "character"; image models skip a DNA with no image or video). Each item can be a public URL or an absolute local file path. Files capped at 25MB each. Those stills are ALL packed into later generations (every image slot the model has, or a white grid if only one leftover slot remains) — so they must share one identity and one vibe.

name.description: Name of the Visual DNA profile. **Pick a short, lowercase, no-space single token** (e.g. `maya`, `tokyo_neon`, `brand_red`, `esther_model`) — never names with spaces (`Sarah Johnson` ❌). The user/LLM types this as `@<name>` inside generation prompts, and the @ parser stops at the first space, so `@Sarah Johnson` matches only `Sarah` and the binding silently drops. Multi-word concepts should use underscores or be a single token. Names are case-insensitive on lookup, but **reserved** values rejected on creation: `Image1`, `Image2`, …, `Video1`, …, `Audio1`, … (any-language characters allowed; max 100 chars).

prompt_helper.description: Optional description/notes to guide DNA extraction

description.description: Alias for `prompt_helper`. Accepted because every tool here REPORTS this field as `description`, so callers round-trip that name back in; without the alias zod stripped it and the notes were silently lost. Ignored when `prompt_helper` is also given.

images.description: Array of image sources (URLs or absolute local paths). Max 4. All of them can reach the model on later gens — same subject, same vibe only; no extra heroes on character DNAs, no main characters on environment DNAs.

video.description: Optional 3-10s video of the subject (URL or absolute local path). Enough on its own: its frames are analyzed for identity.

audio.description: Optional audio source (URL or absolute local path) — the character's voice, 5-30s of clean speech. Stored on the DNA and used two ways: (1) as REFERENCE AUDIO in video generation — pass this DNA's `audio_clips[0].url` in reference_audio_urls on a model with audio slots (Seedance 2.x, Wan 3.0) and the server tells the model it is that character's voice (the web app attaches it for the user; over the API you pass it); (2) as the source for a real speaking voice, but ONLY when you ask for one — see `voice_source`.

voice_source.description: What to do about a SPEAKING voice. **Pass "none" when the audio is just a reference clip** (the usual case for video work) — the clip is stored and usable as video reference audio, and nothing else happens. "clone" mints an ElevenLabs voice from the uploaded audio, which consumes a voice slot and may EVICT another of the user's voices to free one; it also makes the DNA addressable as `dna_<id>` in text-to-speech. "assign" points at an existing voice (pass `assigned_voice_id`). "design" generates a voice from the character's look. ⚠️ Omitting this while passing `audio` keeps the legacy behaviour and CLONES — pass "none" explicitly unless the user asked for a voice.

assigned_voice_id.description: Voice to attach when voice_source="assign" — a `custom_<id>` from the user's clones or a voice_id from `list_voices`.

character_sheet_url.description: URL of a reference sheet (from `generate_character_sheet`, any sheet_type) to set as the DNA's primary reference. Works for ALL DNA types — character turnaround, product detail sheet, location sheet, or style board — and is the single biggest consistency booster. Omit only when the user declines.

project_id.description: Create the DNA inside this project so every teammate with edit access to it can list, fetch and generate with it (pass the same project_id to list_visual_dnas / get_visual_dna / generations). Requires edit access to the project. Omit for a private DNA.

tools.name: list_visual_dnas
tools.description: List the user's OWN Visual DNA profiles. This is almost always what you want — "my characters", "which DNAs do I have", picking a DNA for a generation. Pass `project_id` to also include a shared project's DNAs (teammates' assets on that project). Kolbo ALSO ships a large library of ~1000 global cast/preset DNAs — those are NOT returned by default because dumping them buries the user's own handful. Only pass scope="global" (optionally with `collection` and `search`) when the user explicitly wants to BROWSE the preset cast — e.g. "find me a character", "show me street style models", "I need a lo

scope.description: Default: "personal" — the user's own DNAs (plus a shared project's when project_id is set). "global" = the ~1000 system cast/preset DNAs, for browsing when the user needs a character and has none of their own. "organization" = org-shared. "all" = everything, rarely wanted.

search.description: Search by name, tags, or description (case-insensitive). Matches at WORD STARTS, so "man" finds "Man"/"Manager" but not "woman" or "romantic". Name matches are ranked first.

collection.description: Filter global presets by collection: cast, influencers, props, locations, styles, street

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by (OR logic)

page.description: Page number, 1-indexed. Default: 1. Needed to reach the global cast beyond the first page.

project_id.description: Project ObjectId (from `list_projects`) to ALSO surface that shared project's assets (a teammate's, when the project is shared with you). Requires edit / full / owner on the project — view-only members and non-members get only their own. Omit to see just your own + global/org.

tools.name: get_visual_dna
tools.description: Fetch a single Visual DNA profile by ID. Returns the full stored description, character attributes, and all reference images. Internal extraction system prompts are not exposed. To fetch a teammate's Visual DNA that lives in a shared project, pass project_id (you need edit+ on it).

project_id.description: Project ObjectId (from `list_projects`) to ALSO surface that shared project's assets (a teammate's, when the project is shared with you). Requires edit / full / owner on the project — view-only members and non-members get only their own. Omit to see just your own + global/org.

tools.name: update_visual_dna
tools.description: Edit an existing Visual DNA in place — name, description, type, character sheet, stills, video, audio, or character attributes. NEVER delete and recreate a DNA to change any of those: the old id is what generations, sessions, and @Name bindings already point at. Providing `images` REPLACES the whole still set (max 4) and re-analyzes the profile. Omit images to keep current stills. `video` / `audio` replace only that clip; pass "" to remove it (a voice-only DNA must stay a character). Owner only; global presets cannot be edited (import first). LOCAL FILE? Absolute local paths work here (server

visual_dna_id.description: Visual DNA id from list_visual_dnas / create_visual_dna.

name.description: New name. Same no-space single-token rule as create_visual_dna — @Name binding stops at the first space.

dna_type.description: Type: "character", "style", "product", "scene", "environment". Changing type re-analyzes the profile.

prompt_helper.description: New description / intent notes. Replaces the old ones and re-synthesizes the DNA analysis when the text actually changes. Pass "" to clear.

description.description: Alias for `prompt_helper`. Accepted because every tool here REPORTS this field as `description`, so callers round-trip that name back in; without the alias zod stripped it and the edit silently did nothing. Ignored when `prompt_helper` is also given.

images.description: Full replacement still set (URLs or absolute local paths). Max 4. Omit to keep current stills. Same purity rules as create: one identity, one vibe.

video.description: Replacement video source (URL or absolute local path). Pass "" to remove the DNA's video.

audio.description: Replacement audio source (URL or absolute local path). Pass "" to remove the DNA's voice clip.

character_sheet_url.description: New reference sheet URL (from generate_character_sheet). Sets the DNA's primary sheet without replacing stills.

remove_character_sheet.description: If true, clears the stored character sheet. Do not combine with character_sheet_url.

tools.name: delete_visual_dna
tools.description: Permanently delete a Visual DNA profile. Only the owner can delete. Do NOT use this to rename, restyle, swap stills, or change a description — that is `update_visual_dna`. Confirm with the user before deleting a DNA they did not just create.

visual_dna_id.description: The Visual DNA profile ID to delete

tools.name: generate_character_sheet
tools.description: STANDARD FIRST STEP OF THE ASSET PASS for any film/ad/scene: inventory the characters, locations and props the script needs, generate a sheet for each, create its Visual DNA from that sheet, confirm the whole set with the user, and only THEN generate video. Sheets for cinematic environments and invented characters run well on `mirage-film-2` (3cr); use GPT Image 2.5 Flare/Sunburst or `nano-banana-2` when reference fidelity or legible text matters (this sheet tool does not run GPT Image 2.6 or Nano Banana 2.1 yet; for those, use generate_image_edit with the character-sheet preset). Generate a r

image_urls.description: Reference image URLs of the subject (for characters: front/side/varied angles work best). Use generated-image URLs or upload_media output.

sheet_type.description: Sheet layout. character = front/back/face turnaround. character_headless = wardrobe/body refs with a headless front panel (use when clothing must change without fighting the face sheet). character_bible = denser production model-sheet (turnaround + faces + wardrobe + color swatches). product / environment / style = matching DNA types. Defaults to character. This IS the Character Sheet / Headless / Bible preset — do not call list_presets for those names.

model.description: Image model for the sheet. Default GPT Image 2.5 Flare edit. Accepts gpt-image-2.5-flare / gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2 and nano-banana-2. GPT Image 2.6 and Nano Banana 2.1 are not supported by this tool yet (the server maps them to the 2.5 / Nano Banana 2 rows).

resolution.description: Sheet resolution. 2K or 4K only — never 1K. Default 2K. Use 4K for character_bible, high-detail leads, or when the user asks.

tools.name: list_visual_dna_folders
tools.description: List the user's Visual DNA folders with per-folder item counts. Use to organize large character casts: find the right folder before moving a DNA, or show the user how their characters are grouped. To list the DNAs INSIDE a folder, call `list_visual_dnas` and filter by the `folder_id` field on each profile.

tools.name: create_visual_dna_folder

search.description: Case-insensitive match on name, description and tags.

tools.description: Get one trend: description, the exact inputs it needs (key, kind: image/video/audio/text/choice, role: what the input is (character/pet/product/location/video/text) - a character input also takes a Visual DNA image URL, required, options; min_images/max_images for multi-photo inputs, and sequence: true when the photos are an ordered life sequence, youngest first), output type/aspect ratio, estimated credits, example results and whether a free trial is available.

slug.description: Trend slug from list_trends, e.g. "vanish" or "motion/kolbo-urban-dance-glide".

tools.name: estimate_trend_run
tools.description: Quote a trend run before spending: returns total_credits for these exact inputs (video trends are priced by the source clip length; sequence trends by the photo count). Read min_images / max_images of every photo input from get_trend first. Free — no credits spent.

slug.description: Trend slug from list_trends, e.g. "vanish" or "motion/kolbo-urban-dance-glide".

Media inputs take an https URL (upload local files with upload_media / create_upload_ticket first); a photo input with max_images > 1 also takes an ARRAY of photos of the same subject. The photo limit is set PER TREND: read min_images / max_images for that input from get_trend (or list_trends) and send a count between them; the server rejects anything outside. Without a sequence flag, more photos = better likeness. An input with sequence: true (Growing Up workflow trends) is an ordered life sequence of ONE person or pet: send the photos IN LIFE ORDER, youngest first; each neighbouring pair becomes one transition clip, so order matters and the price scales with the photo count. Text inputs take plain text.

Waits up to wait_seconds for the result, then returns the run so you can keep checking with get_trend_run. Reuse the same idempotency_key after an uncertain response — a new key starts (and charges) a new run.

consent.description: The user confirmed this is them, or they have the person's permission.

photo_urls.description: 1-8 https photo URLs of the person: one face, sharp, face fully visible. A character sheet counts as one photo.

voice_url.description: 30-60 s of the person speaking, https.

video_url.description: 60 s+ of the person talking to camera; unlocks twin.

tools.name: update_avatar
